title: Split the fat Machine into roles

task.text: Split `Machine` into role interfaces so that every implementation honours everything it promises, and every client asks only for the role it uses. What `BasicPrinter` and `MultiFunction` print, scan and fax must not change.

items: `BasicPrinter` is only a `Printer`; `MultiFunction` plays all three.
`Office.printAll`, `digitise` and `send` take the narrowest role they need.
You may keep `Machine` as a combination of the roles, or remove it.

checks.title: MultiFunction prints, scans and faxes as before
Printer, DocScanner and Fax are one-method roles
Office depends on roles, not on Machine

hints.text: A method that throws `UnsupportedOperationException` is a promise the type cannot keep. Look at which clients use which of the three methods.
One interface per capability: `Printer`, `DocScanner`, `Fax`. Each class implements exactly the ones it can do. Change each `Office` method to take only the role it calls.

lines: final class MultiFunction implements Printer, DocScanner, Fax { ... }
